uploadOnSubmit: Local image — uploaded and swapped for a public URL when you submit
autoDesc: AI completes all 6 steps in order. Best for batch output.
manualDesc: Confirm each step before continuing. Best for fine-tuning.
search: Search tasks, models or reference videos
noMatchDesc: Try another keyword or clear the filter.
subtitle: Add subtitles

promptManager.title: Clone prompt management
promptManager.desc: Manage prompt versions per pipeline step and product category. The active version is used for new generations; existing results are not changed.

shot_video.label: Shot video
shot_video.hint: Sent to the video model for each shot. Placeholders are filled from the shot and the product category.

storyboard_model.label: Storyboard · Model
storyboard_model.hint: Used for start/end frames of model presentation shots. Image 1 is the model and product reference, Image 2 is the scene reference.

storyboard_product.label: Storyboard · Product
storyboard_product.hint: Used for start/end frames of product close-up shots. Image 1 is the product reference, Image 2 is the scene reference.

script_analysis.label: Script analysis
script_analysis.hint: Guidance for analysing the reference video. The output format and shot timeline are appended automatically.

promptManager.categoryHint: A category uses its own active version first, then the "All categories" version, then the built-in default.
promptManager.versionHint: Save your edits in place, or save them as a new version.
promptManager.builtinHint: The built-in default is read-only. Save it as a new version to change it.
promptManager.name: Version name
promptManager.saved: Saved V{version}. Activate it to use it.
promptManager.activated: Activated. New generations will use this version.
promptManager.deleteConfirm: Delete V{version}? This cannot be undone.

subline.setup: Pick the three things below and press the button. AI does the rest.
subline.running: You can leave this page; progress will still be here when you come back.
subline.paused: It stopped part-way last time. Press "Continue" to carry on.
subline.error: Check the reason, fix it, then press "Retry". It carries on from where it stopped.
subline.done: Save it and use it, or make another one.

video.title: Reference video
video.hint: The winning video you want to imitate

product.title: Your product
product.hint: Pick the product you sell from the library

model.title: Model
model.hint: Pick from the model library; it is remembered next time

simple.startHint: Analysis, visuals, videos and the final cut run automatically.

visuals.title: Create the visuals
visuals.desc: Write the script and place your product and model in each shot

videos.title: Generate the videos
videos.desc: Bring each shot to life; this takes the longest

compose.title: Assemble the video
compose.desc: Join the shots into one video

simple.runningHint: Generating the videos usually takes from a few to fifteen minutes.
simple.errorHint: If it keeps failing, open "Step by step" at the top right to see each step.
simple.doneHint: Want to change a shot? Open "Step by step" at the top right.
simple.advancedHint: Review and change each step here. For everyday use, go back to simple mode.

video.allDone: All shots are ready. Continue to the final video.
video.runningHint: Generating in the cloud. Results come back on their own, even if you leave this page.
video.idleHint: Use the button at the top right to generate the remaining shots.
video.failedHint: Some shots failed. You can regenerate all failed shots at once.
video.longTakeHint: Generated together with its neighbours as one continuous take, so the joins do not jump
video.relayHint: This clip ends on the next shot's first frame, so the join is seamless
